Fishermen Rescue Elephant Calf Swept Away in Floodwaters

Fishermen rescued a young elephant calf that had been swept away by floodwaters. They spotted the calf's trunk in the river and were able to save it, subsequently returning it to its mother. The incident was captured on video.
